def passing(run, links, layer="road"):
    """What passed the links in the run: PCU on the road, cyclists on the bike layer."""
    table = run.link_bins_table(layer=layer).to_pandas()
    return table[table["link"].isin(links)]["pcu" if layer == "road" else "travellers"].sum()

    },

)
